stories.title: Wemby delivers career performance with 52 points, 24 rebounds, 8 blocks
stories.summary: Victor Wembanyama had career highs of 52 points and 24 rebounds along with eight blocks to power the Spurs past the Mavericks on Wednesday night.

stories.title: Finals bound? LeBron pumps brakes despite 76ers' blistering start
stories.summary: LeBron James is cautioning against any proclamations the 76ers are NBA Finals-bound despite a blistering 8-1 start.

stories.title: Sources: Miami star WR Toney to have surgery for high ankle sprain
stories.summary: Miami star Malachi Toney has a high ankle sprain and will have surgery, sidelining the receiver for Saturday's game against Notre Dame and beyond.

stories.title: Sources: Ravens finalizing trade with Cardinals for QB Brissett
stories.summary: The Cardinals are finalizing a trade to send quarterback Jacoby Brissett to the Ravens, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport.

stories.title: Sources: Hurts makes appearance at Eagles facility amid recovery from blood clots
stories.summary: Sources said Wednesday was the first time some players had seen Jalen Hurts since he was put on injured reserve because of blood clots in his lungs.
